name: Past Paper
statement:
Six students A, B, C, D, E and F take a test and obtain different scores. The following is their conversation.
A says, 'my score is higher than the scores of C, E and F.'
B says, 'my score is higher than the scores of A, E and F.'
C says, 'my score is higher than the scores of exactly one of A and E.'
D says, 'my score is higher than the score of B.'
E says, 'my score is higher than the scores of exactly two of A, B and F.'
F says, 'my score is higher than the scores of exactly two of B, C and E.'
It is known that exactly one of the students is lying. Arrange the scores of these students in descending order.
